brand.name: DealLakay
brand.concept: A professional, modern, and trustworthy technology marketplace tailored for Haiti. Serious and commercial, steering clear of eBay/FB Marketplace clones. Emphasizing trust through seller verification badges and a clean, high-contrast UI.

headings.usage: Bold, clean, tech-forward headings. Tracking tight for larger sizes.

body.usage: Highly legible body text, perfect for dense product details and marketplace UI.

primary.description: Tech Blue - conveys trust, security, and modern technology.

secondary.description: Deal Yellow - used for highlights, sale tags, and the prominent 'Sell' button to draw attention.

layouts.hero: High-impact hero section with a bold heading ('Jwenn sa w bezwen. Vann sa w pa bezwen.'), a subtitle, and a prominent centered search bar that includes a category dropdown. Clean background with subtle tech patterns or a soft split layout.
layouts.grid: Bento-style or strictly aligned grid system for product cards (mobile: 2 cols, desktop: 4-5 cols). Consistent heights and alignments.
layouts.navigation_mobile: Fixed bottom navigation bar with 5 items: Home, Search, Sell, Messages, Profile. The 'Sell' button must be prominent (e.g., floating or highlighted in secondary color).
layouts.navigation_desktop: Sticky glassmorphism header with logo, search, category links, and user actions (Sell, Messages, Profile).

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders (#E2E8F0) on cards and containers. Avoid heavy shadows; use crisp borders and soft ambient shadows (shadow-sm) on hover.
visual_enhancers.radii: Subtle rounding (rounded-lg or rounded-xl) for components to feel approachable but serious.
visual_enhancers.badges: Pill-shaped badges for verifications (Email Verified, Phone Verified, Seller Verified, IMEI Verified). Use small crisp icons and success/primary colors for trust.

product_card.style: Flat surface, 1px border. Image container at top with a light gray background to make product pop. Price heavily weighted (e.g., text-xl font-bold text-primary). Condition and location as small muted text. Verification badges floating or neatly placed under seller name.

search_bar.style: Large, pill-shaped or rounded-lg input field with a contrasting 'Search' button. Should stand out as the primary tool for finding tech.

buttons.primary: Solid primary color, white text, bold font, hover:bg-blue-700.
buttons.sell_prominent: Can use secondary color (Yellow) for high conversion, or Primary with a distinct icon.

hero_background_or_user.description: Man smiling and holding phone, great for trust/hero section

icons.instruction: Use lucide-react for all standard UI icons (search, user, home, plus, message-circle, badge-check for verifications).

motion.interactions: Smooth hover states on all interactive elements. Buttons scale down slightly on active (active:scale-95). Product cards subtly lift on hover.

content_requirements.hero_title: Jwenn sa w bezwen. Vann sa w pa bezwen.
content_requirements.hero_subtitle: Telefòn, laptop, pyès, akseswa ak teknoloji disponib toupre ou ann Ayiti.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Make DealLakay distinctive and commercial.
Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for header over content. Use glassmorphism.
Do not center align the app container text.
Use 2-3x more spacing for breathing room.
All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='hero-search-input').
Prioritize Shadcn/UI for logic-heavy components like selects and modals, but customize them heavily with Tailwind to match the brand.
